name: weave
title: weave / Touchstone
description: Dark operations HUD for a cooperative-agent harness. Makes distributed state legible in real time and stops cold at irreversible effects.

typography.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
typography.webfonts: None ship: Inter and JetBrains Mono are used when installed, else the system stack (system-ui / ui-monospace) — docs/plans/2026-10-23-redesign.md
typography.rule: Inter for what a human wrote, mono for what a machine produced.

assetRules: currentColor does not cross an : inline weave-mark.svg, or use weave-mark-accent.svg.
No double hyphen inside an SVG comment — strict XML parse, silent failure.

voice.register: Terse, technically precise, quietly confident. Written for an operator who already knows what a lease is.
rules: Sentence case headings; uppercase only in the mono register.
Lead with the state, then the caveat.
